caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic bowl positioned centrally on a light beige background with no other objects present. The bowl is white with a slight grayish shading indicating depth and shadow inside and along its rim. Around the outside of the bowl, there is a painted decorative floral design that includes a blue flower, a small red flower, and green leaves extending from thin, curving black stems. The bowl has a slightly flared rim and a narrow base. There is a subtle reflection on the inner surface, giving the bowl a glazed appearance. The bottom of the artwork, just below the bowl, features a small handwritten signature or inscription.
title: Cup
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
